Alistar.summary: He is a tank, so pulling him into your team rarely pays off and usually just hands him an engage.

Braum.summary: A tank you should not pull: a grab gives him a chance to all-in with his ult, or he can simply W back to an ally.

Morgana.summary: Her Black Shield blocks your hook and undermines your whole game plan.

Bard.summary: A favorable lane; land a hook and he is easy to burst.

Rakan.summary: A skill matchup where whoever lands first usually wins. You can interrupt his shield or W dash, but if his knockup lands first you rarely trade back in time.

Nami.summary: A ranged support with no mobility; a landed hook usually means a kill.

Zyra.summary: Immobile and ranged, but her plants can block your hook, so aim around them.

Ezreal.summary: While his blink is available your hook is effectively useless against him, so wait for it to be on cooldown.

Janna.summary: A ranged support with a bit more mobility, and she can knock you away with her ult right after you hook her.

Pyke.summary: He is very mobile and hard to hook in open lane, so only target him when his cooldowns are down. If you land the hook, use E immediately to cancel his dash.

Karma.summary: A mobile ranged support who can poke you down heavily if you play loose.

Leona.summary: Another tank you should avoid pulling into your own team.

Lulu.summary: She cannot defend herself well in lane but becomes a real threat later, so punish her early.

Nautilus.summary: A tank you do not want to hook into your team.

Senna.summary: Immobile, so hooking her is usually enough to win the exchange.

TahmKench.summary: Rarely played, and the author sees him as no real concern.

Sett.summary: Think very carefully before hooking him, since pulling him in can backfire.

Taric.summary: The author considers him weak and rarely seen, so he is not much of a threat.

Yuumi.summary: Catching her while detached usually wins the lane, but she becomes a major late-game threat if left alone.

Brand.summary: If your team cannot burst him right after the hook, he will land his full combo on you.
